_comment: Example-area locations for the settlement-change viewer. They provide historical context and driver tags (conflict / flood / arrivals / growth); sources support the described historical event or driver, not the settlement-change raster. Coordinates are approximate town centres. period is 'war' (2016->2018) or 'post' (2019->2023).
